title: 相邻质数之间的最大间隔
description: 把不超过 $n$ 的质数从小到大排列，输出其中相邻两个质数的差的**最大值**。
hint: 先用埃氏筛求出 $n$ 以内的所有质数，再扫描一遍求相邻差的最大值。

solutions.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n0 = int(data[0])
n = n0
sv = [True] * (n + 1)
sv[0] = False
if n >= 1:
    sv[1] = False
p = 2
while p * p <= n:
    if sv[p]:
        q = p * p
        while q <= n:
            sv[q] = False
            q += p
    p += 1
prev = -1
best = 0
v = 2
while v <= n:
    if sv[v]:
        if prev >= 0 and v - prev > best:
            best = v - prev
        prev = v
    v += 1
print(best)
